arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR\nSHAAM TAK NAIZE PE DETI THI DUHAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL\nALL THE WAY TO SHAAM SHE CRIED OUT TO THE SPEAR FOR A VEIL

arabic text: JISKE BABA NE ODHAAYI THI RIDA KAABE KO\nUSKI BETI KE KISI NE NA ODHAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: SHE WHOSE FATHER DRAPED THE KAABA IN ITS MANTLE\nYET NO ONE DRAPED A VEIL UPON HER DAUGHTER

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: BAS YAHI KEHTI THI ABBAS KE SAR SE ZAINAB\nMERE BHAI, MERE BHAI, MERE BHAI CHAADAR
english translation text: THIS ALONE ZAINAB (SA) SAID BESIDE THE HEAD OF ABBAS (SA)\nMY BROTHER, MY BROTHER, MY BROTHER — A VEIL

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: SHARM SE CHHUP GAYI SAJJAD KE PEECHHE ZAINAB\nHIND ZINDAAN MEIN JO ODHE HUWE AAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: IN HER MODESTY ZAINAB (SA) HID BEHIND SAJJAD (AS)\nWHEN HIND CAME INTO THE PRISON WEARING A VEIL

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: PAAON KHAT DETE RAHE DOOR TALAK BACHI KE\nSHIMR NE AISE SAKINA SE CHUDAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: THE CHILD'S FEET LEFT THEIR TRAILING MARKS FAR ALONG THE GROUND\nSO VIOLENTLY DID SHIMR TEAR THE VEIL FROM SAKINA (SA)

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: GIR PADI KHAAK PE ABBAS KI MAA SADME SE\nAPNE BAAZU SE JO ZAINAB NE HATAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: THE MOTHER OF ABBAS (SA) FELL TO THE DUST FROM THE SHOCK\nWHEN ZAINAB (SA) DREW THE VEIL BACK FROM HER OWN ARM

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: HAAYE ROTE HUWE ZAINAB NE KIYA SHUKR-E-KHUDA\nSAR PE SUGHRA KE NAZAR JIS GHADI AAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: WEEPING, ZAINAB (SA) GAVE THANKS TO GOD\nTHE MOMENT SHE SAW A VEIL UPON SUGHRA'S (SA) HEAD

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: ZINDAGI MEIN NA ODHAA PAAYE MAGAR AABID NE\nQABR PAR BAALI SAKINA KE ODHAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: IN HER LIFETIME AABID (AS) COULD NOT DRAPE ONE UPON HER, BUT\nUPON THE GRAVE OF YOUNG SAKINA (SA) HE DRAPED A VEIL

arabic text: HAAYE ABBAS KI BEHNO NE NA PAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: ALAS, THE SISTERS OF ABBAS (SA) WERE LEFT WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: MIR SAJJAD JO LOOTA HUWA ASBAAB MILA\nPEHLE SAJJAD NE AANKHON SE LAGAAYI CHAADAR
english translation text: MIR — WHEN SAJJAD (AS) RECEIVED BACK THE PLUNDERED BELONGINGS\nIT WAS THE VEIL SAJJAD (AS) FIRST PRESSED TO HIS EYES
